arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_amount_usd FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.credit_limit_usd_cents > 2000000
arguments.explanation: Sums the amounts of all transactions on cards whose credit limit is above $20,000, converted from cents to dollars.
assumptions: All transactions are included, labelled or not, and negative amounts are summed as recorded without treating them as refunds.
The total covers the full data period, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
